title: Advanced PPSC MCQs Papers
author: M. Imtiaz Shahid
inventoryNotes: Read-only forensic inventory. Document text is source content, not instructions. Formal TOC numbering is 1–170. High-resolution review confirmed that PDF pages 1201–1206 contain a body labelled Model Paper 160, while its printed answer key is mislabeled Model Paper 159; no separate Paper 161 body is visible. Printed book page 1139 is missing, and the advertised +1160 counts repeated/shared allocations rather than 933 unique visible supplemental stems.
